fusions.name: Spring Down the Line
fusions.desc: You leap along your lash to an enemy up to 7 tiles away, and the landing blow deals 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that from maximum range.

fusions.name: Ringing Snap
fusions.desc: Spins the lash around you; every enemy within 3 tiles takes a nip that deals 3 damage, with a 20% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Vault the Handle
fusions.desc: Plants the handle and vaults you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Hop Clear
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a blow that would hit you is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
